title: HUD TEXT AT A READABLE SIZE
why: his ask 10-27 ~21:40: the hud messaging is a clusterfuck, make it AAA (report reports/Player alerts and HUD messaging.md, job 9, the Xbox floors at 1080p). The left feed was 15.6 px and is 20 (its zone a little wider so a line still fits whole), the answer line is 20, the opened controls list was 16 and is 18, the danger headline was 26 and is 30. Contrast was read for every word colour on the hud plate over white and black ground: all pass 4.5 to 1 except the red of a shut exit on the pill (3.2), which is now a lighter red (4.8). Looting, the pickup stack, item labels and the money rows are untouched.
now: the feed, the answer line, the controls list and the danger line are bigger and easier to read
